description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named CardFlip that manages a card flipping animation demo with stacked card views. It handles touch gestures to flip cards or rotate entire stacks, manages the layout and card stack states, and defines methods to animate card flips and rotations.

classes.name: CardFlip
classes.description: Main activity class managing the card flip and rotation animations, gesture handling, and layout for the card flip demo.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and creates the initial set of card views.

methods.name: addNewCard
methods.description: Creates and adds a new CardView to a specified stack, positioning it appropriately.

methods.name: getStack
methods.description: Determines which stack (left or right) a gesture occurs on based on touch X coordinate.

methods.name: rotateCardView
methods.description: Handles the logic to flip a specific card between stacks, based on velocity and gesture direction.

methods.name: rotateCards
methods.description: Animates all cards in a stack to rotate either in or out about a specified corner.

methods.name: rotateCardsFullRotation
methods.description: Animates all cards in a stack to perform a full rotation around a corner.

methods.name: onCardFlipEnd
methods.description: Callback invoked when a card flip animation ends, re-enabling touch events.

methods.name: onCardFlipStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when a card flip animation starts, disabling touch events.
